lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Ontario Premier Doug Ford and Alberta Premier Danielle Smith expressed optimism Monday that Canada could see a trade deal reached with the U.S. before the end of the year, The Canadian Press reports.
Nvidia led a tremendous rally on Wall Street on Monday following the surprise return of Jensen Huang as its CEO, The Canadian Press reports.
Trump orders the Army not to detonate bomb-making chemicals in Iowa without court approval, Toronto Star reports.
Ukraine claims it sank Russian warship in Libya, Zelenskyy hails surprise attack, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
